description: Brick 4: the sigma->J map's geometric carrier — the Bring vertex V=[1:i:-1:-i:0] (on-curve exact) is fixed by the (2,4,5) order-4 rotation with multiplier exactly i = the democratic q, so dU|_V = J|_V (J automorphism-realized); conjugation swaps the +-i multiplier families (= bar on the degenerate pair = conjugation on spec(J)); the order-4 quotient is genus-1 = E_{5tau0}, the dominant Jacobian factor. The tau target is now concrete. Derives no clause; nothing wired.
tier: symbolic-exact (sympy; on-curve check, projective multipliers, Riemann-Hurwitz)

assertions.name: vertex_on_bring_exact
assertions.detail: V=[1:i:-1:-i:0] satisfies H1=H2=H3=0 exactly — the vertex coordinates are the 4th roots of unity (+0); Bring's 30 vertices are the permutations of this point (Braden-Disney-Hogg Prop 3.9)

assertions.name: order4_multiplier_is_democratic_q
assertions.detail: the 4-cycle maps V to i*V exactly — projectively fixed with MULTIPLIER i; at a holomorphic fixed point the differential acts on the tangent line by the multiplier, and multiplication by i on the holomorphic tangent line IS J: dU|_V = i = J|_V. The (2,4,5) order-4 rotation realizes J by an automorphism, with multiplier = the democratic q = i

assertions.name: conjugation_swaps_multiplier_families
assertions.detail: conj(V)=[1:-i:-1:i:0] is fixed with multiplier -i — complex conjugation swaps the (+i)- and (-i)-multiplier vertex families EXACTLY as bar exchanges the degenerate points q=+-i (brick-3 B3) and as conjugation exchanges spec(J): the degenerate involution structure is geometrically realized

assertions.name: order4_quotient_is_E5tau0_factor
assertions.detail: Riemann-Hurwitz with exactly the two multiplier-+-i vertices ramified (index 4): 2*g_B-2 = 4*(2g'-2) + 2*3 => g' = 1 — the elliptic quotient; per the paper (SS4.3, Weber's T) it has j = -25/2 = j(5*tau0), the SAME E_{5tau0} appearing with multiplicity 3 in Jac(Bring) ~ E_{5tau0}^3 x E_{tau0} (Prop 4.6): the democratic/order-4 structure quotients onto the dominant Jacobian factor

result.multiplier: i at V (dU|_V = J|_V); -i at conj(V); conjugation swaps the families
result.quotient: genus(B/<U>)=1 = E_{5tau0} (j=-25/2), the x3 Jacobian factor
result.tau_target: dU at the vertex pair — concrete geometric target for sigma_ss(q=+-i)
result.verdict: GEOMETRIC CARRIER FOUND (scope-(a); derives no clause; no fit; nothing wired): the degenerate braiding data is realized ON the Bring surface exactly — V=[1:i:-1:-i:0] lies on Bring (G1); the (2,4,5) order-4 rotation fixes it with multiplier exactly i = the democratic q, so dU|_V = J|_V (J is automorphism-realized at the vertices, G2); complex conjugation swaps the +-i multiplier families exactly as bar swaps the degenerate points / conjugation swaps spec(J) (G3); and the order-4 quotient is the genus-1 E_{5tau0} — the dominant Jacobian factor (G4). The tau target of sigma_ss(q=+-i)=+-i is now CONCRETE: dU at the vertex pair. Remaining wall (unchanged): the functorial statement tau(braiding) = this automorphism action, whose classical limit inherits the conformal structure and hence a0 (Clause A). NO tier change.
